parameters.content:
## Airbnb Listing Price & Location Finder

**Actor:** [Airbnb Listing Price & Location Finder](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/airbnb-listing-price-and-location-finder)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/airbnb-listing-price-and-location-finder.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `location` (string)
- `placeId` (string)
- `neighborhood` (string)
- `bbox` (object)
- `listingUrls` (array)
- `listingIds` (array)
- `checkIn` (string)
- `checkOut` (string)
- `adults` (integer)
- `children` (integer)
- `infants` (integer)

### Output fields
- `name` (Name)
- `nightlyPrice` (Nightly price)
- `totalPrice` (Stay total)
- `currency` (Currency)
- `rating` (Rating)
- `reviewCount` (Reviews)
- `location` (Location)
- `roomType` (Room type)
- `url` (URL)

description: Airbnb price scraper: runs the Airbnb Listing Price & Location Finder Apify Actor, returns name, nightlyPrice, totalPrice, rating, reviewCount and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
